clues.text: Samson found a fresh one from a donkey and took it up to fight the Philistines.
With this in his hand, Samson struck down a thousand Philistine men.
Samson made up a short song saying that with this he had piled his enemies into heaps.
When Samson finished his victory song, he threw this from his hand and named the place Ramath-lehi.
Samson grabbed this right after the ropes on his arms became like burnt flax and fell from his hands.
The men of Judah tied Samson with two new ropes and handed him over, but he broke free and used this as his weapon.
After Samson won a great victory with this, he was so thirsty that God opened a hollow place at Lehi to give him water.
